title: ODOC-437 slice 0b: the --contract seam always requires a binding -- fix the help/docs/docstring and split the marker (LCLI-678 fix)
description:
ODOC-437 slice 0b. RULED by opum-doc at 2026-10-06T01:31Z, option A: the CODE is right and a binding is ALWAYS required for every --contract invocation (src/commands/agent.ts:344-350 routes all of them to runWorkflowBinding, which reads the binding from stdin or --request).

Fix, docs/help/tests only -- no behaviour change:
1. The example at src/core/manifest.ts:938, which `lore help agent` PRINTS, and the two cli-surface.md sites (line 949 example, line 958 prose) must show the binding-on-stdin form the code actually accepts, not the unreachable --task-only form.
2. The stale facade docstring at src/commands/agent.ts:337-341 must be corrected to match 217-224 and 344-348.
3. SPLIT the marker: today an empty/absent binding (agent.ts:234) and a profile-or-task not_found (326-327) both emit OPUM_WORKFLOW_LORE_ABSENT. Give an absent binding its own code, distinct from not-found. Both measured on installed 0.12.0.

Evidence, reproduction and the full cause are on LCLI-678. Disjoint from Slice 1 (this touches manifest.ts, agent.ts and docs; Slice 1 touches retrieval/selection).

acceptanceCriteria.text: help agent no longer prints the --task-only contract example; it and the two cli-surface.md sites show the binding-on-stdin form.
The stale facade docstring (agent.ts:337-341) matches the implementation (the binding seam owns every --contract call).
An absent/empty binding yields its own marker, distinct from a profile-or-task not_found; both are documented in cli-contract.md.
bun run lint, bun run typecheck, bun run lore check and the tests pass.

plan: 1. Claim LCLI-679 and commit the claim on the branch (OFLE-249 order).
2. Layer A: correct the help and docs text (the manifest example that `lore help agent` prints, the two cli-surface sites, and the stale agent.ts facade docstring).
3. Layer B: split the marker so an absent/empty binding gets its own code, distinct from a profile-or-task not_found; document it in cli-contract and pin it with tests.
4. Independent review, then push, PR, required checks on the exact head, squash-merge, complete.
implementationNotes: Round 1 findings and their round-2 fixes: (major 1) the docs overclaimed that an UNREADABLE stdin yields BINDING_ABSENT - narrowed to empty-or-absent at all four sites with no behaviour change, and the misclassification filed as LCLI-685; (major 2) the cli-surface binding-seam row kept a stale no-task qualifier - dropped; (minor) the row claimed a stdout error envelope that does not exist - replaced with stdout-byte-empty plus marker-on-stderr.
finalSummary: Closed LCLI-679, ODOC-437 slice 0b, the LCLI-678 fix. Ruled option A by opum-doc (2026-10-06T01:31Z) and confirmed in scope by DEC-165 (3): the --contract opum-agent-workflow/v1 seam ALWAYS requires a request binding, so the help example, the two cli-surface sites and a stale source docstring were corrected, and the empty-or-absent-binding case gained its own ADDITIVE stderr marker OPUM_WORKFLOW_LORE_BINDING_ABSENT, distinct from the profile-or-task not_found that keeps OPUM_WORKFLOW_LORE_ABSENT. The unreadable-stdin misclassification was split out by leader ruling and is LCLI-685, whose remedy DEC-165 (3) already ruled: both paths report BINDING_ABSENT. Evidence: the split is pinned both ways by test/lcli679-binding-absent-marker.test.ts; lore check, typecheck and lint exit 0; full suite 4936 pass / 1 skip / 2 fail, both pre-existing and control-checked (LCLI-614 and the PATH-bun LCLI-648). Round 1 review run wf_be10c269-a6e returned changes-requested; round 2 run wf_4a657570-7d9 approved. PR opum-ai/lore-cli#494. Criterion advanced: ODOC-437 slice 0b. Release gate: a lore release carrying this waits until opum-cli accepts BINDING_ABSENT (DEC-165 (4)).
